subject: journey/nautilus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A single landscape 3:2 illustration for the historical atlas sketchbook of Jules Verne's Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea. A nineteenth-century naturalist's field sketch in graphite and sepia pen with restrained transparent watercolour washes on warm ivory paper. Fine irregular parallel hatching, economical contour lines, a few details sharply observed; leave areas of cream paper around irregular unfinished edges. One coherent scene that reads at small sizes. No captions, labels, border, binding, signatures, photorealism, modern equipment, or Disney submarine designs. A stretch of pale luminous seawater at night, smooth swells softly glowing off-white to the horizon, sky dark above with faint reflected light. Two tiny figures at the far edge of a narrow iron submarine platform in foreground. Soft continuous luminous field, no sparkling wave tips.
